name: PAT_PHENO_CITATION
description: Citations for phenotypes extracted from notes using AI.

columns.name: PAT_PHENO_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the phenotype record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: CITED_NOTE_ID
columns.description: HNO ID of the Note cited in generating this phenotype.

columns.name: CITED_NOTE_CSN_ID
columns.description: HNO CSN of the Note cited in generating this phenotype.

columns.name: CITATION_TEXT
columns.description: The text that serves as a citation for an extracted phenotype.

columns.name: CITATION_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: Stores the local instant that an extraction was generated.

columns.name: FEEDBACK_IDENT
columns.description: Stores the feedback ID from the LLM response which is used to submit feedback when the extracted PHE record is acted on by an end user.
